scope: Four targeted Rogue revisions after actual-size independent review

items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a BRAND NEW original EXACTLY SQUARE hand-painted fantasy-strategy ability icon for Idlever, revision replacing a too-dark detailed draft. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: angular expressive anatomy, broad gouache/oil paint planes and visible brushstrokes, bold contours, midnight navy and blue-violet, warm ivory highlights, strong restrained crimson, sparing worn gold. Charismatic classic RTS skill painting, not realistic illustration or 3D render. A single emphatic close-up gesture fills85percent; huge shapes with only3tones per material, bright focal mass covers at leastone-third canvas and stays legible at24px. Background is flat near-black painted shadow. No moon, towers, scenery, tiny detail, pores, fibres, stitches, photographic lighting, lens effects, vector pictogram, text, letters, numbers, frame, border, UI or signature. Original character/art, no copied game assets. AFTERIMAGE: a rogue moves so quickly that the broad sweeping crimson cloak leaves ONE large pale ivory-blue ghost profile behind. Strong contrasting TWO interlocking silhouettes only: real rogue's huge angular grinning profile on the right, ivory translucent hooded profile on the left, separated by a clean navy wedge. A huge gloved hand pulls the crimson cloak across the lower half in a curved arc. Both faces are visibly stylized, confident, with exaggerated brows. No dagger, no second solid person, no busy motion trails. The near-white ghost face and crimson cloak are the dominant shapes, NOT a tiny floating ghost behind a dark portrait.
